command.scope: Five explicit recovery/regression files, every declared test selected with pattern .*; concurrency1. Existing assertions, scales and individual budgets stay in the identified source. Not the full suite.

metadata.environmentPolicy: Isolated HOME/USERPROFILE/XDG/Git identity/config/credentials/TEMP. Five explicit files run serially on one identified source snapshot. Preserve new performance/recovery fixtures and historical atomic-stage/R02 evidence.

completeScope: Only the complete consistent unindented Node summary in a verified final trailer matching the terminal result.summary. This flag is not a product PASS or a hierarchy claim.

redactions: Known stage/temp/profile/source roots, including repeated escaped separators
provenance.unknownAbsolutePathPolicy: Refuse unknown absolute Windows/UNC and profile paths; only observed Git/Node installation roots may remain.

limitations: Flat rows retain original indentation and IDs without inventing parent/child relations.
Observed PASS/FAIL maps only ok/not ok; explicit SKIP/TODO directives are preserved separately, never converted into an environment classification.
Only immediately associated Node-style YAML diagnostics are parsed. Unsupported/ambiguous fields retain line ranges and hashes as unparsed metadata.
Cancelled parent/child semantics are not reconstructed; Node final totals remain authoritative for the recorded campaign.
A row-count mismatch or parsing ambiguity is declared and never corrected by inventing or removing results.
No totals are combined with a retry, reproduction, focus or other campaign.
